name: oxbshw/watch-skill
description: A skill that turns video, audio, and screen activity into searchable timestamped evidence, with a watch skill and a loop skill, plus an MCP server and CLI for capture and search.
install: pip install 'watch-skill[standard]' (and ocr/loop variants) and npx skills add oxbshw/watch-skill -g, plus npx --yes @deepwatch/cli setup
